notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-040-Q01_3 'TAKE CARE HIGH CRASH ZONE NEXT ... km' (2025, page 3 of 6), fully dimensioned, 3300 x 1800. Red sign: red edge 30 + white border 30 (the sheet's 30 / 60), r 130, white legend on Class 400 retroreflective red. The '*' diamond is the sheet's 'insert appropriate warning sign option - refer page 6': the six crash-scene options of page 6 (1-4 side impact, 5 head on, 6 rear end) are generated as variants, each scene the sheet PDF's own vector artwork placed in the diamond as page 6 draws it; the inset diamond is 900 side (note 2), yellow edge 15 + black border 30, r 60 (the QLD W-series values at that size; not dimensioned on this sheet), and the sheet's dimensions run to its rounded tips. Distance '**' = 'insert appropriate distance' with no example: 2, 5 and 10 km generated (Russell: the variants that make sense, not every value). Chain 200 / 200E / 240 / 180E / 180 / 180E / 240 / 180E-155Em / 200 = 1800: cap tops 200, 640, 1000, 1420 (NEXT and numeral 180 Series E, km 155 Series E modified lower case, one baseline). Diamond: left tip 100 from the left edge, centred vertically. TAKE CARE ends 220 from the right edge (the sheet's '220'); the other lines centred on x 2254 as drawn (measured 2255 / 2251 / 2257). Word gaps measured: 137, 133; NEXT to the dashed numeral box 206, box 187 wide, box to km 140.
